identity_master.prompt_summary: Original super-deformed chibi Thương Tu master with steel-blue/antique-gold combat hanfu, asymmetrical hair ornament and two-hand spear stance with no weapon rendered; single character, transparent background.

animation_sheet_rules: 4 columns x 6 rows; each row is Idle, Walk, Attack, Cast, Hit, Downed; four visibly distinct adjacent full-body pose cels; direction genuinely redrawn, no flip; no held weapons or VFX; transparent background; fixed master identity.

front.prompt_summary: Use the exact identity master; create 24 full-body body-only cels in a 4x6 grid, facing front; preserve unique asymmetric design and continuity, no mirror, no rig, no held weapons or VFX.
front.postprocessing: Selected crop-safe variant and/or alpha cleanup are recorded in the clip manifest.

right.prompt_summary: Use the exact identity master; create 24 full-body body-only cels in a 4x6 grid, facing right; preserve unique asymmetric design and continuity, no mirror, no rig, no held weapons or VFX.
right.postprocessing: Selected crop-safe variant and/or alpha cleanup are recorded in the clip manifest.

back.source_tool: built-in image_gen; identity master and clean back-view reference, then background-removal pass
back.prompt_summary: Six rows of actions × four distinct back-facing poses; no face/eyes; 4x6 RGBA sheet; candidate only.

left.prompt_summary: Use the exact identity master; create 24 full-body body-only cels in a 4x6 grid, facing left; preserve unique asymmetric design and continuity, no mirror, no rig, no held weapons or VFX.
left.postprocessing: Selected crop-safe variant and/or alpha cleanup are recorded in the clip manifest.

limitation: The candidate AI sheets were not corrected by neighboring-frame inpainting/onion-skin. No owner approval is implied. Weapon overlay/grip metadata is separate and remains pending.

front_source_repair.note: Restored un-eroded source after visual review found holes in hair/face.

right_source_repair.note: Restored intact silhouette after alpha erosion found in the previous selected sheet.

right_downed_repair.tool: built-in image_gen background removal from AS55 master and existing Right source reference
right_downed_repair.layout: 2x2; four sequential full-body cels: crouch, knee down, hands down, prone
right_downed_repair.alpha_policy: alpha<64 zeroed in exported frame cels

right_downed_repair_v2.tool: built-in image_gen; identity master + prior pose sequence; clean transparent RGBA output
right_downed_repair_v2.layout: 2x2; crouch → knee → hands brace → prone; all frames have interior alpha bbox
